title: My Dad Says Never Answer The Landline After Midnight
cta: Tag a friend who never answers calls
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you have broken the rule? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Never answer the landline after midnight.
It rings anyway. Every night. At 12:01.
Last night, Dad was away. So I picked up.
*It laughed. "Good. Now I'm the one inside."
Then I looked at the window.
My reflection was still holding the phone.
